latest_release.name: Cecilia5 v5.4.0
latest_release.body:
## Download binaries

To download the binary installer for Windows or MacOS, go to the official web site : 

[http://ajaxsoundstudio.com/software/cecilia/](http://ajaxsoundstudio.com/software/cecilia/)

## What's new

- Upgraded to python version 3.7.6, wxPython-4.0.7 and pyo 1.0.1
- Lot of bugs and crashes fixed
- New modules: AutoModFilter, Binaural, StateVar2, MatrixReverb, WaveScanSynth and Stutterer
